description: Store (or replace) the credential for a registry host. The platform attaches it to sandbox requests for that host only; it never enters a sandbox and is never returned.

host.description: Registry host or URL, e.g. npm.pkg.github.com

scheme.description: How the registry takes the credential: 'bearer' sends secret as a token, 'basic' sends username and secret

name: save_sandbox_registry
title: Store a private registry credential
